title: A New Choice
text: “In the first place, this is a job for Big Sister, Older Sister, or Panda, not me, I say! What that thing did, stealing a first—that’s an unforgivable act of savagery!”
Rival stealing Father’s first is what’s unforgivable, I say!
“Waaah… dohn-kahn. You should go steal her back then.”
“The one at fault is Rival, I say!”
“Hmm… maybe I should soften you up with a bit more psychological damage before I get to the main topic.”
“You just said psychological damage!?”
“This is payback for turning me into an axle. I think you can endure this much. How many times have you made me your axle… and you’ll keep doing it in the future too, won’t you.”
Confound it, I say. I only did what needed doing, I say. It’s you for not deflecting that’s at fault, I say!
“I became your personal sacred weapon. The least you could do is let me have a little fun of my own once in a while. I even arranged another spear spirit to take over for me after you.”
“Change with that one instead, I say!”
Presumably Ark and the others had reforged what was once the sacred staff into a spear, and that would become the sacred spear weapon carried by the hero after me.
“Nooope, that one has no attachment to you anyway. You’ll just have to settle for me.”
Blast it, I say.
“Now then, let’s talk about the parallel world you walked through—one that branches off and exists as its own large event-world. I bet you’ve forgotten about it too, haven’t you?”
“Just what do you intend to report, I wonder?”

“Right. Never mind the one right after the second loop, which didn’t change much—let’s talk about the world after the next loop, where the Bow Hero died. In that world, the demi-humans and beastmen eventually gained the upper hand. She, who was also the Demon Lord, maintained peaceful rule for a long time. Well… as humanity assimilated, it gradually vanished into the bloodlines of the demi-humans and beastmen, so it became a world of demi-humans, beastmen, and monsters.”

In a sense you could call it the founding of the Demon Lord’s army and humanity’s defeat, but it was peaceful, said the spear spirit. Guh… I didn’t want to hear about what happened after Father got stolen away by Rival, I say.
“As for the next loop— given how much blood you’re coughing up, maybe I shouldn’t say.”
“Hyiiii…”

“That much psychic damage, huh… well, thanks to the previous loop, the worst outcome was avoided. You should be grateful. Ark sometimes comes to check on you, and it’s a good thing you weren’t there to meet him then—he might have made you quit.”

Here I offer a prayer of gratitude to Father, who was sacrificed to Rival, I say. Spear spirit is being viciously cruel, gouging at my old wounds, I say. So Ark comes to see me from time to time, does he.
“From there it branches a few more times, but—the first Filolial timing you probably remember. I aimed and sent you there myself, how was it?”
“Was reuniting with Fleon-chan thanks to you, I wonder?”
“Well, yeah. Otherwise you’d have kept looping in a living-corpse state forever, seemed like.”
Guh… its personality is terrible, but it seems to be true that it restored my spirit.

“That world developed civilization as a bridge between two worlds that had never connected. Sometimes wars broke out between the two, but eventually they came to coexist. Well, in the world where she achieved her true goal, that other world also ended in victory for the Demon Lord’s army. The reincarnators were wiped out.”
“Just what is the structure of the world I keep looping through, I wonder?”

“Want to know? Specifically, it’s a spacetime with only two worlds: the one that merged in the very first world—the one Glass and you call her world—and this world. That’s different from the base world.”
I see, I say.

“Now, the world you traveled through this time is shaping up to be different from the others—a world where a highly advanced magical civilization is being built. At least within the span of your natural lifespan, dramatic civilizational development occurred, didn’t it? That’s why so many envoys came from the future.”
Rafuemon and Filoko-chan, I say. Rafumi? Never heard of her, I say.
“Well, once the secret of the frontier settlement is unraveled, the flow of the ley lines becomes active—that’s the cause. So, how about it, hearing about the futures of various worlds?”
“So parallel worlds keep forming, I see.”

“That’s right. In the end, it’s possible the spirits will each take charge of whichever timeline they like and truly split it off as a new world, but for now, at least, they’re parallel worlds. It’s a world where the loadable data that girl Raphtalia mentioned isn’t just one single state, nor has it vanished.”
Well then, said spear spirit, pausing the conversation, I say.

“It’s a foolish question, probably, but what do you want to do from here? If being Motoyasu Kitamura has become too painful and unbearable, do you want to forget everything and go back to your original world?”
“I will not go back, I say. I will keep moving forward for Filo-tan and Father’s sake, I say.”

Ark and Hou-kun paved the way for me. Countless new encounters and events await with the Fathers I couldn’t save, I say. I will pile up regret upon regret, I say. I will look back, and still move forward, and become a strength for Filo-tan and Father, I say.
“I see. So then, what next? Will you choose and go back? For instance… the choice that surfaced in your mind in the world where she ultimately won you over.”
Swiftly, spear spirit conjured up a hazy image of that moment, I say.
→ Let Sakura-chan go to Fiancée’s side.
Do not let Sakura-chan go to Fiancée’s side.

That choice from back then, I say. What would happen if I let Sakura-chan go to Fiancée’s side there? When Father was exhausted on the terrace, sleepy-eyed Sakura-chan came and he got away, I say. If only… I could go back to that moment, I say. But… spear spirit had already told me parallel worlds had formed, and Ark and Hou-kun had explained as much.
“I have a question, I say.”
“What is it? nano.”

Don’t tack on that fake-sounding verbal tic, I say. It is deeply regrettable that you would imitate Rival, I say. The thought of some guy saying “nano” at the end of his sentences is more unsettling than Rival herself, I say.
“Supposing I made that choice, would the world where Rival ended up in a romantic relationship with Father be rewound and reconstructed?”
“Oh? You noticed that, huh. You really are sharp after all. Nano.”
“Answer me, I say.”
“Motoyasu Kitamura. Which do you want it to be? Nano.”

At that question I think it over once more, I say. Motoyasu, isn’t the Father who chose Rival still Father to you? Is that why you think it’s fine to rewind the choice and erase it as if it never happened? No! I am the man who decided that the Fathers who vanished still exist, I say. It is not a choice I may make—erasing them just because it’s inconvenient, I say.
“It will not rewind, I say. It branches from there instead, I say.”
“Correct answer. It just means another parallel world gets created, but how about it? If you start from that branch point, you could save the Filolial eggs from being smashed beforehand.”

Spear spirit was offering a choice that shook my heart violently, I say. But that too was only a matter for a parallel world, I say. That world of that particular Father could no longer be changed, I say.
“Of course, I’ll go there eventually, I say. To turn the hamster wheel, I say.”
“Good to hear. Do your best at it until you’re satisfied.”

I can recall it vaguely now—I did run away from home for a while, but I came back and properly blessed Father, I say. Ah, Father… I feel sorry that I couldn’t understand your true intentions at the time, I say. It was all for my sake, I say. He knew that if he didn’t calm Rival down, she would rampage in the subsequent loops, and so he settled things down, I see.
“…I hope you can meet that him from that parallel world again someday too. You’re heading to the same destination, after all.”
Spear spirit was saying something incomprehensible again, I say.
“Well, since we’ve come this far, I suppose I have to properly explain something to you.”
“What is it, I wonder?”

“Your goal was to start looping in order to try again in a world that got erased, but beyond that… Ark mentioned an endless dream that keeps stretching longer, and by repeating cause and effect, Filo’s strength increases too, but the margin of that increase changes. Doing the same kind of actions is inefficient.”
So by looping, I become of use to Father and Filo-tan, I see.
“In other words, not jumping right after the very first summoning means…”

“You’ve already built yourself a winning pattern, haven’t you? Showing the other Heroes the crime scene, bringing the Queen of Melromarc, and crushing the conspiracy—that flow. You should think up different choices and act on them.”
Is this advice from spear spirit, I wonder?

“Well, where you jump to, I sometimes decide by dice roll, but since you get purified each time you loop and lose a lot of memory, it’s hard for things to end up exactly the same—but there are limits.”
Duplication must be avoided, I see.
“I’ll keep using you to explore various possibilities on my end too, so go ahead and get to it.”
Here, with a floaty sensation, my body began to rise, I say.
“Now then, thanks to the effects of the loop, you’ve come to know more things and can do more things too. Given that fact, let’s see what you do next.”
“I’ll make you my axle again, I say.”
“You never run out of backtalk, do you. Well, off you go. Go explore the possibilities as you see fit.”

With a “see ya” sort of air, spear spirit saw me off, I say. Gah… if I had a spear in hand I’d skewer it with one Gungnir strike, I say. No, wait, running in Drive Mode would be better, I say. If I remember, I’ll do it, I say. Incidentally, out of spite, I forgot to use Drive Mode. I do it right after, though.
Choice Regression
Let Sakura-chan go to Fiancée’s side.

Favor Tiger Girl. Favor Tiger Girl. Favor Tiger Girl. Arrange Tiger Girl for Father. Arrange Tiger Girl for Father. Snatch Tiger Girl away from Tiger Guy and leave her with Father along with medicine.

Tiger Girl, that passion of yours is admirable, nano. But naofumi likes the docile you better, nano—you’re the superior version, nano. I am who I am! I will absolutely be the one who follows him! I will never give up! If naofumi were gentle, I think your personality would change too, nano.
Random Regression ←
Second Coordinate…… Referencing…… Cross-checking…… Regression Commencing——
Before I knew it, I found myself in a bustling marketplace, my arms full of several Filolial-sama eggs.
“This is…”
“Moto, what’s wrong~?”
I lowered my gaze toward the voice, and there, instead of Black Thunder, stood Kuro-chan—the form that results when I raise the egg from which Black Thunder would have hatched.
“It’s Kuro-chan, I say.”
“Yep. It’s Kuro. Moto the Love Hunter <Drive> is gonna make Kuro some clothes, right~?”

Kuro-chan’s clothes weren’t made yet, so she was wearing just a cloak. When and where was this, I wonder. At the very least, among all my loops up to now—before looping again—the loops in which Kuro-chan is present are limited, I say. Was this… the loop where I crushed the conspiracy together with Ren, Itsuki, and the Queen?
A chill of unpleasant sweat ran down my spine, I say. There had been loops where I met Kuro-chan in between being retrieved by Big Sister, but even then, I had properly saved Father, hadn’t I.
“Kuro-chan. I need you to tell me, I say. Where is Father, I wonder?”
“Eh? Nao? Nao said goodbye yesterday, going off to some country or other, did Moto forget~?”
“Guh!!”

In other words, this loop was almost the very first one, I say. This was during the time when I still didn’t properly understand the rules of looping—right after I’d saved Father from the false charges and entrusted him to the Siltvelt envoy, and was casually trying to raise Filolial-sama while searching for Filo-tan, I say!
“Piyo piyo!”
At my feet was also a growing Filolial-sama. I could vividly recall even the future form it would take—by tomorrow, surely, becoming an angel, I say.
“This is an emergency, I say!”

In other words, at some point at least by tomorrow, something was going to happen to Father and he was going to die—that kind of loop, I say! Spear spirit, you dropped me into a troublesome timing, I say!
“Kuro-chan. I just remembered urgent business, I say. Time is of the essence, so please take these Filolial-sama eggs and everyone back to the inn ahead of me and wait there, I say.”
“Ehh, but it sounds like there’s some unavoidable event <mission> in the Dark Saint Hero’s Adventure Chronicle <Dark Brave Chronicle> that looks fun, so Kuro wants to go too~”
“That is not something I can allow right now, I say. I will introduce Kuro-chan to a playmate destiny <Destiny> later, so please be patient, I say.”

I’ll have Ren serve as Kuro-chan’s playmate later, I say. Since Kuro-chan is Black Thunder, surely she can properly awaken Ren, I say! Oh? Somewhere in my mind, Ren, who has once become an Inult, seems to be screaming “stop it!”—but since another Ren, who gets along well with a different Black Thunder, is striking a cool pose, it should be fine, I say. As for the portal… ugh, I hadn’t acquired one at exactly the right location.
“Ehh~? Really~? Okaaay, Kuro will house-sit with everyone~ Destiny!”
“Then I’m off, I say! Drive Mode!”
At once I used my spear to enter Drive Mode, spinning my wheels at high speed and tearing off, I say.
“Buhya!?”
“Whoa!? What is that thing!?”
“Gross!?”
Vroom, vroom—I tore through the castle town, blasted straight through the castle gate, and headed off in a beeline toward Siltvelt, I say.
This concludes the Retrospective Arc. Starting next time, we move on to the Slave Trader Arc… the Tutorial Arc Another.
